body.x: DEVICEMALL (CEO Choe Du-jin, www.devicemall.co.kr) showcased its Portable and Rechargeable Customized Generator in the joint pavilion of the Mobile Technology Convergence Center (MTCC) at the world’s best IT technology exhibition ‘CES(Consumer Technology Show) 2016’ which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas Convention Center(LVCC).

DEVICEMALL’s flagship product “Portable and Rechargeable Customized Generator” uses lithium-ion secondary batteries. There is no restriction on its use, as it does not emit smoke and make noise, when compared to existing generators.
Furthermore, it is durable enough to be recharged more than 2,000 times. And it possesses high-power output of over 150W/kg.
The product’s parts, including the voltage, capacity, output, and case, can be customized according to users’ needs.

The company also showcased the Pure Sinewave Inverter (DC to AC). This product changes DC to AC power. It has a voltage range of 12 to 72V and a capacity of 300 to 6,000W. With its compact size and heat dissipation structure, it operates stably.

By using the micom control, it is a pure sine wave invertor, with minimal distortion. It has high efficiency of more than 85%. To protect internal circuits, it is equipped with a cooling fan. The company has also acquired various certificates, including ISO9001, CE, RoHS, and FCC, verifying the safety of the product.

DEVICEMALL CEO Choe Du-jin said: “This year, we will develop a compact yet powerful battery pack that combines high-performance lithium-ion secondary batteries and highly efficient power conversion and storage technologies. In the future, we will set sights on new fields, including IoT, robots, and new renewable energy sources.”
DEVICEMALL has showcased power devices and power conversion systems for the leisure and industry fields, all by utilizing lithium-ion secondary batteries.

The company provides battery packs with various voltage and capacity options, as well as customized battery backs and solutions. In particular, it is expanding its business into the electrical component field for EV and solar cars, and conducting future-oriented research and development of new renewable energy sources.

MTCC prepared the joint pavilion at this exhibition and supported related domestic companies’ participation in CES 2016, promoting the creative factory supporting business. It is mainly focused on the competitiveness reinforcement business of new mobile convergence in the global market.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), CES 2016 is the world's largest exhibition to see the latest global trends in electronics and IT industry in one spot.

AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES for 11 years to introduce the new technologies and products. After the local coverage and research, AVING News will hold ‘CES 2016 Review Conference’ in AVING Studio, Korea on January 28th.
